config.description: Edits a message the bot already sent.

config.source: var a = input.function; var body = { chat_id: String(a.recipient), message_id: Number(a.id), text: String(a.text) };  var modes = { text: null, markdown: 'MarkdownV2', html: 'HTML' }; if (a.format) { if (!(a.format in modes)) throw new Error('--format takes text, markdown or html'); if (modes[a.format]) body.parse_mode = modes[a.format]; } var keyboard = a.keyboard; if (typeof keyboard === 'string' && keyboard.trim() !== '') keyboard = JSON.parse(keyboard); if (keyboard && typeof keyboard === 'object') { var rows = []; Object.keys(keyboard).forEach(function (label) { [].concat(keyboard[label]).forEach(function (data) { rows.push([{ text: label, callback_data: String(data) }]); }); }); if (rows.length) body.reply_markup = { inline_keyboard: rows }; }  return { method: 'editMessageText', body: body };

var r = input.response || {}; var b = r.body || {}; if (b.ok !== true || !b.result || typeof b.result !== 'object') throw new Error('Telegram refused the message: ' + (b.description || ('HTTP ' + r.status))); var m = b.result; var out = { id: m.message_id, recipient: m.chat ? m.chat.id : null, sent_at: new Date(m.date * 1000).toISOString() }; if (m.edit_date) out.edited_at = new Date(m.edit_date * 1000).toISOString(); out.telegram = m; return out;
